description: Get the campaigns a shared negative keyword list is attached to. Use this to detect a list attached to the very campaign built to target those terms, which silently blocks its own keywords. bing_ads_list_shared_entities returns only an AssociationCount, not which campaigns.

account_id.description: The account ID (uses context if not provided)

entity_type.description: What the list is attached TO, defaults to Campaign

shared_entity_ids.description: One or more shared list IDs. The API allows one per call, so several ids are fanned out and merged automatically.

shared_entity_type.description: What the list IS, defaults to NegativeKeywordList

name: bing_ads_get_shared_entity_associations
